name: Taylor Swift
description: American singer-songwriter famous for her narrative songs about love and life. Known for hits like 'Love Story' and 'Shake It Off'.

name: Melanie Martinez
description: American singer-songwriter known for her dark, theatrical pop style. Breakthrough with 'Dollhouse' and 'Pity Party'.

name: The Beatles
description: Legendary English rock band from Liverpool. Iconic songs include 'Hey Jude', 'Let It Be', and 'Yesterday'.

name: Billie Eilish
description: American singer-songwriter with a unique whispery vocal style. Famous for 'Bad Guy' and 'Everything I Wanted'.

name: Ed Sheeran
description: English singer-songwriter blending acoustic pop with heartfelt lyrics. Known for 'Shape of You' and 'Perfect'.

name: Adele
description: English singer-songwriter celebrated for her soulful voice and powerful ballads. Famous for 'Hello' and 'Rolling in the Deep'.

name: Ariana Grande
description: American singer and actress with a wide vocal range. Known for 'Thank U, Next' and '7 Rings'.

name: Drake
description: Canadian rapper and singer known for his catchy hooks and introspective lyrics. Famous for 'God's Plan' and 'Hotline Bling'.

name: Beyoncé
description: American singer and performer known for her powerful vocals and stage presence. Hits include 'Single Ladies' and 'Halo'.

name: Kendrick Lamar
description: American rapper known for socially conscious lyrics and storytelling. Recognized for 'HUMBLE.' and 'Alright'.

name: Lady Gaga
description: American singer and performer known for her theatrical style. Famous for 'Bad Romance' and 'Shallow'.

name: Shawn Mendes
description: Canadian singer-songwriter recognized for heartfelt pop hits. Known for 'Stitches' and 'Señorita'.

name: Dua Lipa
description: English singer blending dance-pop and retro influences. Famous for 'Levitating' and 'Don't Start Now'.

name: Bruno Mars
description: American singer-songwriter mixing funk, R&B, and pop. Hits include 'Uptown Funk' and '24K Magic'.

name: Post Malone
description: American rapper and singer blending hip-hop and pop. Known for 'Circles' and 'Rockstar'.

name: Selena Gomez
description: American singer and actress, popular for her pop hits. Known for 'Lose You to Love Me' and 'Come & Get It'.

name: Harry Styles
description: English singer and songwriter, former member of One Direction. Famous for 'Watermelon Sugar' and 'Sign of the Times'.

name: Imagine Dragons
description: American pop-rock band known for energetic stadium anthems. Hits include 'Radioactive' and 'Believer'.

name: Rihanna
description: Barbadian singer and businesswoman, blending R&B, pop, and dance. Famous for 'Diamonds' and 'Work'.

name: Coldplay
description: British rock band known for melodic, emotional music and stadium performances. Hits include 'Fix You' and 'Viva La Vida'.
